scenes.title_cn: 先做面基底，再做鼻基底
scenes.title_en: Base the Face First, Then the Nose
scenes.context: 想成为顶级美女，面中部必须非常优越。第一个坑：很多人喜欢先把鼻基底垫起来，但垫完并不好看，因为中轴线这一条线立体了，其他位置跟不上。所以做鼻基底之前，先要把面基底的位置做得很优越。语域：美学分析，专业讲解。
sentences: 想成为顶级美女，面中部必须非常优越。
To be a top-tier beauty, your midface must be outstanding.
top-tier beauty（顶级美女）；midface（面中部）
很多人喜欢先把鼻基底垫起来，但垫完并不好看。
Many people pad the nasal base first — but it never looks good.
pad the nasal base（垫鼻基底）
中轴线立体了，其他位置还跟不上。
The midline becomes 3D while the rest lags behind.
the midline（中轴线）；lags behind（跟不上）
paraphrase: 面中部 → midface / the middle of the face
垫鼻基底 → pad the nasal base / augment the nose base
pad the nasal base · augment the nose
scenes.speak: To be a top-tier beauty, your midface must be outstanding. Many people pad the nasal base first — but it never looks good. The midline becomes 3D while the rest lags behind.

scenes.title_cn: 面基底的位置：婴儿肥在哪
scenes.title_en: Where the Face Base Goes: The Baby Fat Spot
scenes.context: 面基底做在哪里要仔细分析。有人喜欢按常规打在这个区域让脸饱满，但颧骨高的同学会连成一片，面中很长。真正好看的顶级美女，纯天然的婴儿肥大概是在这个位置——既缩短中庭，又让面部有呼吸感，还能弱化颧骨。语域：美学分析，位置讲解。
sentences: 有人喜欢按常规打在这个区域，让脸比较饱满。
Some fill the usual zone for a fuller face.
the usual zone（常规区域）
但如果你颧骨高，这里连成一片，面中会很长。
But with high cheekbones it all blends together and the midface grows long.
high cheekbones（颧骨高）；blends together（连成一片）
纯天然的婴儿肥，大概是在这个位置。
Natural baby fat sits roughly right here.
baby fat（婴儿肥）
paraphrase: 颧骨高 → high cheekbones / prominent cheekbones
婴儿肥 → baby fat / natural fullness
scenes.speak: Some fill the usual zone for a fuller face. But with high cheekbones it all blends together and the midface grows long. Natural baby fat sits roughly right here.

scenes.title_en: The Nasal Base and the Maxillary Arch
scenes.context: 做完面基底我们才可以做鼻基底。如果是长中庭，需要做凸面脸，显得立体、中庭短。鼻基底凹陷很严重的，会有上颌发育不足，容易误判成反颌。所以做鼻基底一定要把上颌弓的位置也做起来。语域：美学分析，进阶讲解。
sentences: 如果你是长中庭，需要做一个凸面脸。
With a long midface, you need a convex face shape.
a convex face shape（凸面脸）
鼻基底凹陷很严重，应该会有上颌发育不足。
Severe nasal-base indentation usually means a weak upper jaw.
a weak upper jaw（上颌发育不足）
做鼻基底，一定要把上颌弓的位置也做起来。
When doing the nasal base, you must also build up the maxillary arch.
the maxillary arch（上颌弓）
paraphrase: 凸面脸 → convex face / projected profile
上颌发育不足 → weak upper jaw / underdeveloped maxilla
scenes.speak: With a long midface, you need a convex face shape. Severe nasal-base indentation usually means a weak upper jaw. When doing the nasal base, you must also build up the maxillary arch.

scenes.context: 骨相整形要用加法思维：眼眶骨这一圈都要立体，眉骨、双C、山根都很重要。下巴不能往前兜；面中能立体到这个程度，下颌线就不必担心。真正的骨相做加法的思维，是更长久更抗衰的。语域：美学分析，总结升华。
sentences: 骨相要做加法，眼眶骨这一圈都要立体。
Enhance the skeleton additively — the whole orbital rim should read 3D.
the orbital rim（眼眶骨）；additively（做加法）
有些时候你很瘦还没有下颌线，就不要死磕这里。
If you're thin but still lack a jawline, stop fixating on it.
stop fixating on it（不要死磕）
骨相做加法的思维，是更长久更抗衰的。
Additive bone work is more lasting and more anti-aging.
anti-aging（抗衰）
paraphrase: 做加法 → additive work / build up, not remove
scenes.speak: Enhance the skeleton additively — the whole orbital rim should read 3D. If you're thin but still lack a jawline, stop fixating on it. Additive bone work is more lasting and more anti-aging.

practice: Base the face first, then the nose — many pad the nasal base first and it never looks good.
Natural baby fat sits roughly right here — it shortens the midface.
Severe nasal-base indentation usually means a weak upper jaw.
Additive bone work is more lasting and more anti-aging.
pitfalls: The middle of the face is very good.
「面中部优越」用 midface is outstanding，不用 middle of face is good。
With high cheekbones it all blends together.
The nose base is very low.
Severe nasal-base indentation usually means a weak upper jaw.
shifts: 用 top-tier beauty（顶级美女）、midface（面中部）、outstanding（优越）
用 pad the nasal base（垫鼻基底）、build up（做起来）、maxillary arch（上颌弓）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：河面→面中部、红化→填满/饱满、全骨→颧骨、中挺→中庭、上阳弓→上颌弓、反颌→凸面、夹体→假体、喉哗→奇怪、私藏相识→似曾相识、牙公→颌骨、发肌线→发际线、抗摔→抗衰等。
